summary: Completed testing of Multi-Cloud Backup and Attorney Live Stream features. All 22 backend tests passed. Frontend Settings page and Encounter page verified with all new UI elements working correctly.
passed_tests: POST /api/auth/login - returns access_token and user data
GET /api/backup/providers - returns enabled providers (aws_s3, ipfs_pinata, local_storage)
GET /api/backup/status/{evidence_id} - returns not found for non-existent evidence
POST /api/backup/evidence/{evidence_id} - requires file upload (returns 422 without file)
POST /api/backup/evidence/{evidence_id} - uploads evidence to multiple clouds successfully
POST /api/attorney-stream/create - creates stream session with stream_code and tokens
POST /api/attorney-stream/create - accepts notification_method parameter (email, sms, both, in-app)
POST /api/attorney-stream/join - attorney joins with valid token
frontend_tests_passed: Login page loads and login with test@example.com / password123 succeeds
Attorney Stream Settings section visible with Scale icon
Notification Method dropdown has 4 options: Email Only, SMS Only, Email + SMS, In-App Only
Attorney settings save to localStorage correctly
Toast notification 'Attorney settings saved' shown on save
5 protection level options present (Save Only, Share with Contacts, Share with Attorney, Livestream, All Options)
critical_code_review_comments: Multi-Cloud Backup service properly initializes S3, IPFS (Pinata), and Local storage providers
Attorney Stream service generates secure tokens for user and attorney access
WebRTC signaling endpoints properly implemented for peer-to-peer streaming
Notification method parameter correctly passed through create stream flow
Frontend Settings page properly saves attorney settings to localStorage
Encounter page correctly loads attorney settings from localStorage for pre-filling
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-Cloud Backup and Attorney Live Stream features fully implemented and tested. Backend services support S3, IPFS (Pinata), and Local storage for evidence backup. Attorney Stream supports WebRTC signaling, chat messages, and multiple notification methods (email, sms, both, in-app). Frontend Settings page has Attorney Stream Settings section with all configuration options. Encounter page has protection level options including 'Share with Attorney'.
